meta.title: 5 minutes
meta.author: Icefall
meta.description: 5 minutes by Icefall, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 6) taken from the V2M collection of jgilje/v2m-player (`v2m/Icefall--5_minutes.v2mz`; its README points to modland). 120 BPM, 5:05, 16 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
